changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO match_players (match_id, position, player_name) SELECT m.match_id, (t.ordinality - 1)::int, t.player_name FROM matches m, LATERAL unnest(m.players) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(player_name, ordinality) WHERE m.players IS NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO match_scores (match_id, player_name, score) SELECT m.match_id, kv.key, kv.value::int FROM matches m, LATERAL jsonb_each_text(m.result -> 'finalScores') AS kv(key, value) WHERE m.result IS NOT NULL AND m.result -> 'finalScores' IS NOT NULL;
UPDATE matches SET coin_count = (result -> 'config' ->> 'coinCount')::int, step_delay_ms = (result -> 'config' ->> 'stepDelayMs')::bigint WHERE result IS NOT NULL AND result -> 'config' IS NOT NULL;

rollback.sql: UPDATE matches SET coin_count = NULL, step_delay_ms = NULL;
